title: I built a multiplayer .io racer in Godot 4 that runs in the browser (full workflow)
author: Horror-Apprehensive
selftext:
For the last 3 days I’ve been building **GRID-SURF.IO**. Think Paper.io, but with neon drift cars that can ride up walls. You leave a light trail, close loops to claim territory, and if someone crosses your line, you crash.

Full disclosure: I’m no coder wizard or even vibecode wizard. I basically "directed" this game while Claude Code wrote all of the code and ran the tests. I made the high-level calls, playtested it to death, and iterated. I thought sharing the actual workflow would be more fun than a standard promo post.

**The Tech & Multiplayer**

* **The Stack:** Godot 4.7 (WebGL2 so it works on phones) hosted on Railway for $5/mo.
* **No Assets:** All the 3D models (Blender), synthwave music, and even the trailer cuts were generated purely through Python scripts. No asset packs, no clicking around.
* **Networking:** The client and server share the exact same physics code. The server runs a headless Godot instance and dictates the state, but your browser predicts your car locally so steering feels instant. It runs incredibly light—about 1-3 KB per snapshot. Bots fill empty slots automatically so you never have to wait for a match.

**The Disasters (The fun part)**  
Building this fast led to some hilarious messes:

* PowerShell variables are case-insensitive. My $g (git) and $G (Godot) aliases were colliding. Every time I typed git commit, it secretly spawned an invisible Godot instance. I found 8 of them quietly melting my CPU.
* I ran 7 AI agents in parallel across different git worktrees. Turns out, git stashes are shared globally—so the AIs kept popping each other's code.

**What I learned**

1. Test on a real phone immediately. Desktop touch emulation will lie to you.
2. Write a deploy script that actually verifies a match can start before calling the update "done."

I’d love some feedback, especially on how it feels on mobile. If you find a bug, let me know, I'm (the ai) fixing stuff fast !

Play here (free, no signups):[ Grid-Surf.io](https://web-client-production-7054.up.railway.app/)
